description: This file implements the VertexDataManager class responsible for managing vertex buffer data, including static, dynamic, and current value attributes, in a Direct3D rendering context within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: VertexDataManager
classes.description: Manages vertex buffer data, including static, dynamic, and current value attributes, for rendering.

classes.name: VertexBufferBinding
classes.description: Represents a binding to a vertex buffer, managing reference counting.

classes.name: TranslatedAttribute
classes.description: Holds translated vertex attribute data for rendering, including buffer references and offsets.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the streaming buffer with a specified size.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Resets and clears the streaming buffer and cache.

methods.name: prepareVertexData
methods.description: Prepares vertex attribute data for rendering, handling static, dynamic, direct, and current value attributes.

methods.name: StoreDirectAttrib
methods.description: Stores direct attribute data from a buffer into the translated attribute structure.

methods.name: StoreStaticAttrib
methods.description: Stores static attribute data from a buffer into a static vertex buffer.

methods.name: storeDynamicAttribs
methods.description: Stores dynamic attribute data into streaming buffers.

methods.name: PromoteDynamicAttribs
methods.description: Promotes dynamic attributes to static buffers after data transfer.

methods.name: reserveSpaceForAttrib
methods.description: Reserves space in buffers for a specific attribute before data transfer.

methods.name: storeDynamicAttrib
methods.description: Stores dynamic attribute data from client memory or buffers into streaming buffers.

methods.name: storeCurrentValue
methods.description: Stores current attribute values into buffers for rendering.
